title: pavonia glabra
intro: Pavonia glabra, commonly known as the smooth rose-mallow, is a plant species belonging to the family Malvaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Pavonia glabra are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that work to reduce pain, fight off infections, and promote tissue repair. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, cough, and other respiratory issues, highlighting its potential as a natural remedy for various health conditions.
